text: Your grip is weak. You elect not to attack because of lack of control.
You lose control as you release the weapon and it falls harmlessly to the ground halfway to your target.
You trip over your own feet. You land face down, but hang on to your weapon.
You begin juggling your weapon because of a bad grip and smack yourself in the head. You are Stunned for 2 rounds.
Poor release. If there is someone else within 15' of the intended target, roll a +0 attack on the closest.
You throw very poorly. The weapon ends up 10 + 1d10 feet away in a random direction and must make a breakage check.
Execute the declared attack on the nearest ally, whoops! (If no ally in range, weapon bounces off an object, comes back at you as a +0 surprise attack.)
What a throw! The weapon flies out twenty feet beyond its normal maximum range past the intended target. If someone is there, roll a +0 attack. You take a -10 Fatigue penalty from your exertion.
Just as you are about to release, you slip and fall prone, and are Stunned[-50] for one round.
Your weapon drops to the ground, hitting your foot on the way for 1d10 hits.
Your poor and weak release sends the weapon up two feet. It immediately comes down and hits you. You take no damage, but are Stunned for one round.
You manage to throw your weapon 4d10 feet behind you. Anyone in the way takes a +0 attack. You are Dazed one round.
You trip as you release your weapon, which flies off to make a +0 attack on the nearest creature. You are Stunned[-50] for two rounds.
You throw the weapon straight up and it comes down as a +50 attack on yourself.
